summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Transportation to create regulations requiring airlines to compensate passengers for significant flight delays or cancellations caused by the airline, specifically $300 for delays of 3 to 9 hours and $775 for delays of 9 hours or more, in addition to rebooking missed connecting flights at no extra cost.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates that the Secretary of Transportation issue regulations requiring air carriers to provide compensation to passengers for significant flight delays or cancellations. This does not involve direct government spending or appropriations, but rather imposes requirements on private entities (airlines).
